_doc: Stream V (Expansion 1 §6): THE VOYAGE between the two continents. `harbours` = one per continent: `master` = where the Harbourmaster NPC stands (WORLD metres, like carts.json stops; js/sim/ships.js placeHarbours puts it in the town room it stands in), `dock` = where a voyage TO this harbour puts you ashore, `seaward` = the way to open water from the dock (tools/ship-routes.mjs walks that way to the first water deep enough for a ship: `berth` = where the ship lies, `pier` = the jetty from the shore to it). `sailings` = from -> to with the fare in gold, the time held (`sec`), and `path` = the sea route in world metres from berth to berth (tools/ship-routes.mjs finds it over data/world/horizon.bin, keeping off the coasts). `volcano` = Vharlen's peak for the ash plume (the client takes the highest ground near it). Re-run `node tools/ship-routes.mjs --write` after any re-bake of the coasts. Port Vharl's quay is stream T's `harbour` placement in data/zones/z13_10/placements.json (zone 1505, 914; world 28129, 21394), ~380 m east of the town on the beach; Gullwick has no sea inside its zone (the coast is ~2 km east, past the playable edge), so its Harbourmaster stands on Gullwick's main street and the ship lies at the real coast east of the town.

service.name: the Narrow Sea Packet
service.line: Three masts, one captain, and no promises about the weather.

refuse.gold: The passage to {town} is {fare} gold. Come back when you have it.
refuse.combat: Not with that after you. Deal with it first.
refuse.closed: The Saltwren is not sailing to {town} yet. The harbour there is still being built.
refuse.level: The sea out there is no place for anyone under level {level}.

says: The Saltwren sails on the tide. Are you coming?
Smoke on the horizon means Vharlen. Fire under the smoke means you have arrived.

master.name: Osric Fennimore
master.title: Harbourmaster
says: The ship lies at the Gull Stair, down the tide road. I sell the passage; the sea does the rest.

master.name: Tavu Okkarin
master.title: Harbourmaster
says: Welcome to Vharlen. Watch the ground: some of it is warm for a reason.
